verified.search_depth: docs: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/api-reference/web/search/get (no page body; lite alone, fast and deep refused)
verified.country: docs: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/api-reference/web/search/get (37 codes; any other refused before the call)
verified.locale: docs: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/api-reference/web/search/get (search_lang from its list; a locale reaches one through constants_languages.py, else refused)
verified.recency: docs: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/api-reference/web/search/get (freshness pd | pw | pm | py by page age, published or last modified)

text_decorations.note: Boolean; highlight markup is stripped from results either way.

result_filter.note: Comma-separated result types; leaving out web leaves the results empty.

goggles.note: A Goggle URL or inline definition that re-ranks results.

extra_snippets.note: Boolean; up to five extra excerpts fill SearchResult.content when returned. Not mapped to a depth: excerpts are not a truncated body (search_depth serves lite alone).

summary.note: Boolean; the summarizer key stays in raw.

enable_rich_callback.note: Boolean; the rich callback key stays in raw.

operators.note: Boolean, default true; whether search operators in q are applied. include_domains and exclude_domains are sent as site: operators, so setting it false through provider_options turns them off.

x-loc-lat.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-long.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-timezone.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-city.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-state.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-state-name.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-country.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-postal-code.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

operators_fallback.note: Boolean, default false: try relaxed operator matching first, falling back to the original results. query.search_operators.applied in raw says whether every result matched the operators.
